title: The BSMT
features:
BSMT Hub — War Tycoon

BSMT is a combat-focused War Tycoon script built with one goal: to kill. It packs a

complete aim suite, weapon modification, base automation, and a full visual/ESP

package into one clean, mobile-friendly UI.

— SAFETY FIRST —

Your safety is our first priority. On execution, BSMT runs a built-in version-integrity

check: it hashes the game's core scripts and compares the result against a verified, known-good version. If War Tycoon receives an update and anything changes, you are notified instantly that the build may be outdated, so you never blindly run a broken or unsafe script.

COMBAT

• Silent Aim

• Show FOV + FOV Radius

• Wallcheck

• Wallbang

• Tracers + Tracer Color

• Rocket Spam (Stinger rockets home onto the nearest enemy) (works with both stinger and rpg)

• RPG Silent Aim (RPG rockets auto-hit the closest target)

• Instant LockOn (instant missile lock for Stinger/Javelin)

• LockOn Players

• LockOn Wall Check

• Kill Aura (Rage) + Wall Check + Target Limit + Ignore Forcefield

GUN MOD

• Enable Gun Mod (customize your weapons)

• No Recoil

• No Spread

• Full Auto (makes any gun full-auto)

• Instant Reload

• Fire Rate

• Bullet Speed

• Range

• Bullets/Shot

BASE / TYCOON

• Auto Build (auto-buys tycoon buttons)

• Target Lowest Price

• Target Rebirth Buttons

• CRAM Kill Aura (auto-fires your CRAM at targets)

→ Target Players / Helicopters / Vehicles / Planes / Tanks / Boats / Drones

→ Ignore LP Vehicles

WORLD

• Grenade Alert

• Airdrop Alert

• Obstacle Hit Alert

• Auto Farm (auto-steals crates/airdrops to your collector)

• Target Crates / Target Airdrops

• Crate ESP (Name / Distance / Status / Ignore Own Crates)

VISUALS

• Player ESP (Name, Box, Health Bar, Backpack Items, Skeleton, Tracers)

• Box Style (Full / Corner / 3D)

• Tracer Origin (Bottom / Top / Mouse / Center) + Tracer Color

• Chams (Fill / Outline / Occluded color + transparency)

• Minimap Player Dots (works on minimap + full map) + Enemies Only

LOCALPLAYER

• Fly + Fly Speed

• No Fall Damage

• Noclip

• Spin Bot (anti-aim) + Spin Speed

FUN / MOVEMENT

• Moon Gravity + Gravity slider

• Super Jump + Jump Power

• Infinite Jump

• Custom WalkSpeed

• Freecam + Freecam Speed

• Rainbow Trail

• Anti AFK

MISC

• Spoof Memory Stats (anti-detection)

• Teleport To Bullet

• Cool Atmosphere

Fully mobile supported.
